name: When should a small business consider investing in AEO?

mainEntity.name: When should a small business consider investing in AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small business should consider AEO when its target audience frequently uses voice search, relies on AI assistants for information, or if its competitors are already exploring AI-driven strategies. It's particularly beneficial if your business offers niche services, local products, or detailed information that can be effectively summarized by AI. Early adoption allows your business to gain a competitive edge as AI continues to shape how users find information and make purchasing decisions. If you're experiencing declining organic traffic or want to future-proof your digital marketing efforts, investing in AEO can be a strategic move.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small business should consider AEO if their customers use voice search or AI assistants, or if they want to future-proof their digital marketing strategy.
